summary: Recorded the last uncited receipt in the run (4ed46b198c8d41618cc855df0a63d469, the first attempt at the three-voter commit-rule harness of experiment 6b30dd76) as a provenance limitation on the configuration-recovery account, citing only its group-start event: that execution failed in construction ("snapshot on A failed: nothing new to snapshot") and produced no witness, so it must not be read as evidence either way, and the case's actual witnesses remain the later harness revision's receipts. The account's conclusion (violated, defect asserted), sources, executions, counterevidence and defect judgment are unchanged. With the run's remaining interval too short to build, run and cite the InstallSnapshot discriminator, that open question was left as the source-only account already registered rather than starting a probe whose receipt could not be cited.
